CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2603 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 4649c7d531330970aa31b76afea523ae23d66b70. Bus nonce: 5fd97fcc866baaa0a0cd219c646ceb88. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 4649c7d531330970aa31b76afea523ae23d66b70`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 4649c7d531330970aa31b76afea523ae23d66b70` or `Fix review: blocked 4649c7d531330970aa31b76afea523ae23d66b70 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 5fd97fcc866baaa0a0cd219c646ceb88`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `4649c7d531330970aa31b76afea523ae23d66b70` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2603 4649c7d531330970aa31b76afea523ae23d66b70") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2603-5fd97fcc`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for the roster sync PR #2603 (group R10-ROSTER, branch fix/audit-r10-roster-11) at head 4649c7d531330970aa31b76afea523ae23d66b70. - The carry records the owner's request, which the PR body quotes verbatim. tvofi, 2026-10-22: "For the docs PRs, I want a buymeacoffee button added to the top of the repo README and at the bottom of the web page, leading to buymeacoffee.com/rpgshcwb2tp".
- Judge whether the carry text asks for exactly that, routed to the right group:
  - R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST is the docs PR whose files include README.md, and tools/site/build_docs.mjs per O-1.
  - Check that the site footer is produced by files in that group's reach.
  - R10-ARCH-DOCS verifying it is consistent with its rescoped brief.
- The carry's requirement of in-tree assets (no hotlinked third-party image or script) must agree with the tree's own site rules: check docs/site, the CSP if there is one, and tests that forbid external assets.
- node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs at the head gives 0 errors. carry_audit.py check over the body gives 0 unrouted. Every Carry in your verdict names a live group on main's roster.
- Re-measure every figure in the body: 148 groups, 1 changed.
- Read check-runs at this head. A red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" or "API is unreachable" is external. nightly-status and delivery-status grade main and are not required. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 4649c7d531330970aa31b76afea523ae23d66b70 must be clean.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 5fd97fcc866baaa0a0cd219c646ceb88. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
